Based on Citigroup Inc.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, the figures are reported as follows:

### **1. Citigroup Consolidated**
* **Revenues, net of interest expense:** **$81,139 million** (or approximately **$81.1 billion**)
  * *Sources:* 
    * Accession `0000831001-25-000067`, Section `Filing Summary`, Chunk `f5439905-700b-5f39-9af6-973b47170259`: Under *Revenues: Total Citigroup net revenues* = **$81,139 million**.

    * Accession `0000831001-25-000067`, Section `Filing Summary`, Chunk `f5014461-55d2-564c-a953-797c742d26a0`: *"Citigroup revenues of $81.1 billion in 2024 increased 3% on a reported basis."*

* **Net interest income:** **$54,095 million** (or **$54,189 million** on a taxable equivalent basis)
  * *Sources:* 
    * Accession `0000831001-25-000067`, Section `Filing Summary`, Chunk `d441cb7b-2128-5e5b-89cc-9543fbbc619d`: In Note 4 (*Interest Income and Expense*), Total interest income of $143,713 million less Total interest expense of $89,618 million = **$54,095 million**.
    * Accession `0000831001-25-000067`, Section `Filing Summary`, Chunk `3955f59d-f333-5845-bbab-47febf2b638a`: *Net interest income, taxable equivalent basis* = **$54,189 million** (and reported as $54.1 billion).

* **Non-interest revenue:** **$27,044 million**
  * *Calculation:* 
    $$\text{Non-interest revenue} = \text{Revenues, net of interest expense} - \text{Net interest income}$$
    $$\$81,139\text{ million} - \$54,095\text{ million} = \$27,044\text{ million}$$
  * *(Using taxable equivalent basis: $\$81,139\text{ million} - \$54,189\text{ million} = \$26,950\text{ million}$)*.
